question.text: Grameen Urja Pvt Ltd (a Section 8 FPE) has listed ZCZPs for a rural solar-lighting program and also runs a separate NON-listed skilling program. Ms. Priya Shah, SIA, is advising on AIR preparation. Which statement is accurate under Regulation 91E?

answer.text: Both the solar program and the skilling program require external SIA assessment.
The solar program requires external SIA assessment; the skilling program is self-certified by Grameen Urja.
The solar program is self-certified; the skilling program requires external SIA assessment.
Neither program requires external SIA assessment if Grameen Urja is a FPE - only NPOs need external SIA assessment.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Reg 91E(2) requires external assessment by a SIAO employing SIAs for LISTED projects only. Non-listed projects are self-certified by the SE. The legal form (NPO vs FPE) is irrelevant - what matters is whether the project has an instrument listed on SSE. **The Trap:** Option D embeds the common error that FPEs escape AIR assurance - they don't. Options A and C over/under-apply the 91E regime. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXIII Topic 4 (Eligible Activities) and Topic 9 both test FPE vs NPO treatment; 91E does not turn on legal form. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** In the engagement planning note, draw a 2x2 grid: (NPO/FPE) x (listed/non-listed). Only the two cells in the 'listed' column attract SIA assurance. The grid prevents the SE management from pushing non-listed work into the SIA scope to secure a lower fee.
